blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every company has to pay taxes and follow rules. The main ones are corporate tax on profits, VAT or sales tax on most sales, and payroll taxes on salaries. Each one has its own form, its own deadline, and its own penalty if you miss it.

Compliance means more than paying taxes. It also means keeping records that can be checked, filing reports on time, and answering honestly when the tax office asks questions.

Good accountants treat tax as a calm, regular routine — not as a panic every March. Bad ones do the opposite, and their companies pay for it.

items.q: What are the three main taxes in the text?
options: Sales tax, bank tax, and travel tax
Corporate tax, VAT, and payroll tax
items.why: "corporate tax on profits, VAT or sales tax… and payroll taxes on salaries".

items.q: What happens if you miss a deadline?
items.why: "its own penalty if you miss it" — perder o prazo gera multa.

items.q: According to the text, compliance means MORE than…
items.why: "Compliance means more than paying taxes." Envolve registros, relatórios e respostas honestas.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: "It is fine to do all your tax in a panic in March."
items.why: Inferência: o texto elogia a rotina calma e critica o pânico — logo, discordaria da opção do pânico.

items.q: The last paragraph suggests that…
options: the way you manage tax affects the company
March is the only tax month
items.why: Inferência: "their companies pay for it" — a atitude do contador tem consequências para a empresa.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Charlotte ajudando o novo contador. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team. Today we are going to build a simple tax calendar. The idea is easy: every deadline and every form in one place, so nobody has to panic later.

Let's start with the big three. Corporate tax, VAT, and payroll tax. I want each one on the calendar, with the date it is due and the form we have to file. Payroll tax comes every month, so it needs twelve rows, not one.

Here is my rule. We never wait until the last day. We put a small note three days before each deadline. If the note says "VAT", we file the VAT that week. Calm and early, always.

One more thing. We keep the records for at least five years. So next to each form, write where the file is saved. When the tax office asks a question, we should find the answer in one minute, not one week. Any questions? Good. Let's fill in January first.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What are Charlotte and the new accountant building?
items.why: "we are going to build a simple tax calendar".

items.q: Why does payroll tax need twelve rows?
options: Because it is the biggest tax
Because there are twelve forms per month
Because it is paid once a year
items.why: "Payroll tax comes every month, so it needs twelve rows".

items.q: How long should the records be kept?
items.why: "we keep the records for at least five years".

items.q: Why does Charlotte want a note three days before each deadline?
options: So they can skip the form
So they can pay a smaller tax
So the tax office does not call
So they file early and stay calm
items.why: Inferência: "We never wait until the last day… Calm and early" — o lembrete evita o pânico de última hora.

items.q: Why does she want to write where each file is saved?
options: So they can print more copies
So they can answer the tax office quickly
So they can delete old files
items.why: Inferência: "find the answer in one minute, not one week" — localizar o arquivo rápido quando a receita pergunta.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We paid the tax on our profits last week." A tax is…
options: money you pay to the government
items.why: Tax = imposto: dinheiro pago ao governo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We missed the ___, so now we have to pay a penalty."
items.why: Deadline = prazo. Perder o prazo gera multa.

items.q: "The company must add VAT to almost every sale." VAT is…
items.why: VAT = IVA: imposto sobre a maioria das vendas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Good ___ means keeping clean records and filing on time."
items.why: Compliance = conformidade: seguir as regras, guardar registros e entregar no prazo.

items.q: "When the tax office asks a question, we answer honestly." The tax office is…
options: the government body that collects taxes
items.why: Tax office = receita: o órgão do governo que cobra os impostos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões sobre impostos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager still has to sign off on the tax return." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We need to keep up with every deadline." To keep up with means to…
options: stay on top of it, not fall behind
items.why: Keep up with = acompanhar, não ficar para trás.

items.q: "Please fill in the VAT form." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher o formulário com as informações.

items.q: "The team agreed on the plan but never followed through." They…
options: did not finish what they promised
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "Let's file the report early so we don't run out of time." To run out of means to…
items.why: Run out of = ficar sem algo; aqui, ficar sem tempo.
